name: design-inspiration
description: Finds visual design inspiration for the app in the current repo: works out what the app is, asks a few design questions, searches Dribbble, Awwwards and other free inspiration sites, optionally has you compare pairs of designs so it learns your taste before a targeted search, and publishes a shortlist of 6 to 8 screenshots per app page as a claude.ai Artifact where you rate each one Love / Maybe / No. An optional mockup skill builds a responsive mockup of your pages in the chosen look, which you comment on to have it revised. A plan skill then reads your ratings and notes from that page and has a subagent plan how to apply the chosen designs.
